purpose: Pre-registered non-publishing country-comparison pilot (terra-method-review.md section 3); diagnostics only, never a score, never published
design: 9 pairs x 2 orders x 4 draws (72) + 3 isolated x 4 draws (12) + 3 targets x 2 orientations x 2 draws (12) = 96 calls
blocks: 4 balanced blocks of 24, shuffled within block (seed 20261107); block1 = matrix draw1 + isolated draw1 + copy afirst draw1; block2 = matrix draw2 + isolated draw2 + copy bfirst draw1; block3 = matrix draw3 + isolated draw3 + copy afirst draw2; block4 = matrix draw4 + isolated draw4 + copy bfirst draw2
isolated_realization: single DOS SIER A block, no comparator; same system prompt and scoring task; score_a is the assessment, any emitted score_b recorded but ignored
copy_orientation_realization: dossier renders are byte-identical for these targets, so "A/B formatting reversed" = block-order reversal: afirst = DOS SIER A block first, bfirst = DOS SIER B block first

caps.retry_policy: max one retry per failed call, both attempts logged

optional_evidence_contrast: NOT RUN (out of scope for this pilot)
limitations: four draws = feasibility choice, not power
isolated condition uses a two-dossier system prompt (pre-registered fixed settings), so pair-vs-isolated differs in prompt condition as well as comparator
labels can be inferable from facts
